title: Cory Cowgill
author: HallucinatedGames
selftext:
My kids really like Deep Rock Galactic Survivor, and like fantasy knights and battles. They love to “make” their own games with me and AI so they can make the game work however they want. I have found that taking pictures of them in a T Pose and then using OpenAI to create them into realistic photos in knight armor, wizard robes, etc I can use that to create models of them and put them in the game. I am using ComfyUI, Stable Diffusion, Trellis 2.0 all to build the assets locally on my gaming PC. (I removed their models from  
Demo video for privacy). This is a fun activity our family can do with AI game development.  Claude Code is the harness driving with my boys and I orchestrating.
